title: Can Advanced Metering Infrastructure 2.0 Grid Edge Intelligence Help Address the Affordability Challenge?
content: Across the US, customer affordability is top of mind for customers, utilities, and regulators. Electricity prices have risen nearly 40 percent since 2021, and in 2025 electric and gas utilities requested nearly $31 billion in rate increases, more than double the amount requested in 2024 and affecting approximately 81 million Americans.1 Residential electricity rates also increased 7.3 percent between April 2025 and April 2026, which continues to outpace broader inflation.2
